title: Sunday 101128
wodRaw:
Tabata Weighted pull-up, 30 pound dumbbell  
Rest 1 minute  
Tabata Weighted squat, 45 pound plate  
Rest 1 minute  
Tabata Weighted ring dip, 30 pound dumbbell  
Rest 1 minute  
Tabata Deadlift, 165 pound barbelll  
  
The Tabata interval is 20 seconds of work followed by 10 seconds of rest for 8 intervals.  
Tabata score is the least number of reps performed in any of the eight intervals.  
  
[Michelle Kinney](http://crossfitbartlett.com/) 2 (15lb), 12 (35lb), 3 (15lb), 8 (125lb) = 25  
[Kevin Montoya](http://www.crossfitflexgym.com/) 3, 9, 3, 6 = 21  
Post Tabata score for each exercise to comments and total for final score.
